The wind howled through the pass","severity":"major","reason":"The briefing never says Elias went to the pass or found her body."},{"span":"He pulled a crumpled letter from her pocket","severity":"minor","reason":"The letter exists, but that she carried it on the caravan is an embellishment."}],"voice":3,"clarity":3,"tone":3,"overall":3,"comment":"It ends correctly on Elias's intent to reach Ada, but it invents a scene with Elias at the pass beside her body.
